subject: readHTMLTable works when run in my console, but I get an error when running in my Shiny App

messages.author: 082ef9a95377314e
messages.subject: readHTMLTable works when run in my console, but I get an error when running in my Shiny App
parts:
I have a function that reads an HTML table from a URL, using readHTMLTable from the XML package. It works fine when I run it in my R console but when I try to use it in my Shiny app, I get the following error:

unable to find an inherited method for function ‘readHTMLTable’ for signature ‘"function"’

Is there something I'm missing when it comes to using readHTMLTable() in Shiny?

messages.author: 082ef9a95377314e
messages.subject: Re: readHTMLTable works when run in my console, but I get an error when running in my Shiny App
parts: I solved the issue - apparently readHTMLTable() cannot be called within a function, hence the "inherited method" error.
